title: Unified Dataset Configuration - SPP/PI Optimized
description: Configuration optimized to satisfy PCH, SPP, and PI requirements simultaneously

semanticLayers.name: singleton_simple
semanticLayers.comment: Simple singletons for flat structure + none predicates

semanticLayers.name: singleton_predicate
semanticLayers.comment: Singletons with predicates for single/few predicate counts

semanticLayers.name: pair_and
semanticLayers.comment: Pairs with AND for and_only logic + shallow depth

semanticLayers.name: pair_or
semanticLayers.comment: Pairs with OR for or_only logic

semanticLayers.name: pair_mixed
semanticLayers.comment: Pairs with mixed AND/OR for and_or_mixed logic

semanticLayers.name: negation
semanticLayers.comment: Policies with negation for negation_heavy logic

semanticLayers.name: triple
semanticLayers.comment: Triple combinations for medium/deep nesting + few/many predicates

semanticLayers.name: varied_params
semanticLayers.comment: Ensure diversity in set sizes and ranges

notes: This configuration generates 250 policies (increased from 200) to ensure better coverage
Semantic layers are designed to target specific SPP dimensions:
- singleton_simple: flat + none predicates + none set size
- singleton_predicate: flat + single predicate + small/medium/large set sizes
- pair_or: shallow + or_only logic (via operators option)
- varied_params: ensure diversity in whitelist sizes and merkle depths
1. or_only logic: Requires modifying layer-specific logic options (not currently supported)
2. negation_heavy: Requires ≥2 NOT operators, controlled by notProbability
3. deep nesting: Limited by DEPTH=10 constraint, triple combos are the practical limit
4. many predicates: Hard to achieve (4+ predicates exceed depth limit)
5. range_width: Depends on having range predicates (not in current DUO setup)
